issues.reason: The named obliques apply only when the PP answers where/when/how/whence/whither and the set says to decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest; 'time the harvest TO the tide' names an alignment target, not a whither, so Goal asserts a spatial destination the text does not state and the licensed form is the preposition-named oblique (To sk_time_1 …).

A definite description is a typed witness and an event-denoting noun ('the storm') stays an ordinary sk_ entity rather than a deictic constant, while Compound concepts says the head genus of a minted compound symbol is always emitted — so the untyped, genus-less new_moon_spring_tide violates both and enters the KB linked to nothing.
The per-member rule repeats the Goal head and the untyped constant verbatim, so the same two violations recur inside its consequent.

gaps_confirmed: narrowed: the plural-label rule's 'referring as a name' qualifier has no stated test — though its structure (the common-noun default is singular-collective only) still routes a capitalized plural kind-word label to the Name-only individual

a recurring natural-cycle event NP as a habitual time slot ('the new-moon spring tide'): the time vocabulary has no term for it and the deictic-constant route is speech-anchored only, so the sole licensed carrier is an ordinary typed witness in the surface To oblique, which records the preposition but not the temporal alignment
new_gaps: 'time X to Y' (aligning an occurrence with a recurring event) has no dedicated head — the opaque To oblique is surface-faithful, but a 'when is the harvest?' question cannot bind it as a Time
defect_summary: Issue 0: (To sk_time_1 sk_tide_1) in place of Goal; issue 1: (Member sk_tide_1 new_moon_spring_tide) plus (Inheritance new_moon_spring_tide tide) with the noun modifiers new_moon and spring unexposed, the witness filling the oblique; issue 2: the same two corrections inside the rule consequent — if any rule survives at all.
notes: Unfiled by the reviewer: 'the Keepers' is a capitalized plural kind-word label, which Names and casing makes a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no per-member kind, so keepers_group and the distribution rule are themselves unlicensed. Patient for the timed harvest (an occurrence object) and the salt_bloom_harvest fusion with genus harvest are correct.
